title: Route behavioral fixes to the relevant skill during retro
story: As a developer, I want the retro skill to prompt me to update the relevant skill directly when a behavioral problem is identified, so that the fix takes effect immediately rather than becoming a ticket that may never be actioned.

title: As a developer, i want my agents to be able to get the current iso timestamp for including in ticket fields like groomed_at
acceptance_criteria: there is a skill or script that agents can run to determine the current iso-format timestamp
agents have access to the skill or script when they would need it to populate relevant fields in tickets

title: As a developer I want a script/skill/workflow that automatically uses the rest of my daily claude limit as efficiently as possible
acceptance_criteria: There is a new skill/script/command/workflow that runs this new pattern.
The new entity analyzes remaining daily claude limits and develops a plan of how to use the remaining daily usage as efficiently as possible
Planned usage can be towards refactoring, product updates, workflow improvement suggestions, web/codebase research, and claude workflow improvements.
Changes to the codebase should be isolated to different branches

A summary should be written out (location tbd) on the plan, what actually happened, any issues/bottlenecks/things to improve for next time, and names of the newly created branches and what they contain.

title: Track agent metrics per ticket
story: As a developer, I want relevant agent metrics recorded on each ticket so that I can spot trends and improve my agent usage over time.
acceptance_criteria: Each ticket has an agent_metrics field containing: input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_tokens, thinking_tokens, estimated_cost_usd, turn_count, tool_call_count
Metrics accumulate across multiple sessions on the same ticket (values are added, not replaced)
Metrics are updated at the end of any Claude Code session where a ticket is in_progress
Metrics are not updated when no ticket is in_progress
Metrics are updated when a ticket is marked done

title: As a developer, i'd like to be able to close a ticket without adding it to the current sprint
Django REST Framework setup
story: As a developer, I want DRF installed and configured so that I can build REST API endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: djangorestframework is in requirements.txt
rest_framework is in INSTALLED_APPS
Default renderer is JSON
A health check endpoint GET /api/health/ returns 200 OK

title: JWT authentication configuration
story: As a developer, I want JWT authentication configured so that the React frontend can authenticate API requests with tokens.
acceptance_criteria: djangorestframework-simplejwt is in requirements.txt
POST /api/token/ and POST /api/token/refresh/ endpoints are wired up
Default DRF authentication class is set to JWTAuthentication
Token lifetime is configurable via Django settings

title: User registration and JWT auth endpoints
story: As a user, I want to register and log in so that my writing sessions are saved to my account.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/auth/register/ creates a new user and returns JWT tokens
POST /api/auth/login/ returns JWT tokens for valid credentials
Registration rejects duplicate usernames with a clear error message
Registration rejects empty or too-short passwords with a clear error message
React login and registration forms exist and call these endpoints
On success, tokens are stored in localStorage and the user is considered authenticated

title: Save completed writing sessions to backend
story: As a user, I want my completed writing sessions saved to the backend so that my progress persists across browser sessions.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/sessions/ saves a completed session: user (FK), word, text, duration_seconds, annotations (JSON), word_count, created_at
Claude API analysis moves to the backend using the app owner's API key
The frontend no longer requests or accepts an Anthropic API key from the user
After the timer expires, the frontend POSTs word, text, and duration to the backend; the backend runs analysis and stores results
Unauthenticated requests to POST /api/sessions/ return 401
assumptions: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set in the backend .env

title: Progress trend view with diversity score
story: As a user, I want to see a trend chart of my diversity score over my last 20 sessions so that I can track how well I'm using all the senses in my writing.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/sessions/progress/ returns the last 20 sessions with per-session diversity score
Diversity score = (unique_senses / 7) * (min_count / max_count), range 0.0-1.0
Sessions with no sensory annotations return a score of 0
React renders a line chart of diversity score over time (x = session date, y = score 0-1)
Chart is on a dedicated Progress page accessible after login

title: Refactor Exercise component: extract state hook and phase subcomponents
story: As a developer, I want the Exercise component split so that state logic and rendering are independently testable
acceptance_criteria: All exercise state (phase, word, text, annotations, apiKey, durationSeconds, isValidating, apiKeyError) is extracted into a custom hook with its own test file using renderHook
Each phase (idle, writing, results) is rendered by a separate component that accepts state and callbacks as props
Each phase component has its own test file exercising it independently via props
Each phase component has a Storybook story covering at least its default state
The Exercise component calls the hook and delegates rendering to the phase components
All existing Exercise tests continue to pass
non_goals: Adding new features or fixing bugs beyond those directly enabled by the refactor
Migrating to a different state management approach (e.g., context, Zustand)
assumptions: Storybook is already installed and configured in the project
The current Exercise component has existing tests worth preserving

title: Don't store django secret key in codebase, regenerate key
story: As a developer, I want the Django secret key to not be stored in the codebase so that if the codebase (e.g. github) becomes compromised, my web application will not be instantly hackable

title: Add script to return single ticket.
